playstyle: A heavyweight Mishima-style fighter. Crouch dash (f,n,d,df) into the Electric-style Langue Washer, hellsweep and mids; use his Balance (BAL) stance and big counter-hit tools. Fast and explosive, but his big hurtbox and execution demands mean you must stay sharp on the inputs.

stances.name: Crouch Dash
stances.note: His Mishima-style dash: CD.1 (f,n,d,df+1) is an i13 high that instantly tornadoes on hit, CD.4-style hellsweep (f,n,d,DF+4) is a stagger low.

stances.name: Balance
stances.note: BAL.1,2 is a Heat Engager and +1 on block; BAL.3 is +4 on block. Several moves transition here with F.

keyMoves: i10 jab string, -12 on block if all three finish.
Block, then punish the last hit.
1,1 alone is safer; the full string is -12.
To make the opponent respect mids.
Bite Uppercut: i14 mid, -8 on block, slight jab evasion.
A mid that can duck under jabs.
When the opponent likes to jab you.
Expecting it to keep the turn.
His tool against button presses up close.
Langue Washer (CD.1): i13 high, -4 on block, instant tornado on hit.
His electric-style launcher: fast, safe and huge.
In neutral and as a whiff punish from crouch dash.
Instant tornado: go into his tornado BnB.
The move to practise: it is his best tool.
Abats Snipe: i17 mid launcher, strong jab evasion, -13 on block.
His evasive launcher and i17 punisher.
Punish -17 moves; duck under jabs and launch.
After blocking lows that are -14 or worse.
On block the second hit is -20.
Shrimp Turnover: i19 mid, instant tornado on counter hit (+73a).
Gaufrettes Punch: high string, +1 on block, launches on counter hit.
A plus-on-block high string with a CH launch.
Hellsweep: i18 stagger low, -28 on block.
Out of crouch dash once the opponent respects CD.1.
The low half of his crouch-dash mix-up.
Liaison Spike: i20 low, -12 on block, +14g on counter hit.
Spicy Ring: Heat Engager string, -13 on block.
One of his Heat Engagers and an i13 punisher.
Use as a punish to start Heat.
Cooler Shaker: i12 throw, break with 1 or 2, side switch.
